title: Streets added to Troy snow removal operations - NewsBreak
text:
By Kristina Handy ,
1 hours ago
TROY, N.Y. ( NEWS10 ) — Additional streets have been designated for snow removal operations in Troy, according to the mayor’s office on Wednesday. Affected residents are urged to follow newly posted signage and parking restrictions.
Get the latest news, weather, sports and entertainment delivered right to your inbox! Snow removal on the added streets will take place from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Thursday and from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Friday. “No Parking” signs have already been placed on one side of the affected streets for Thursday, and additional signs will be posted on the opposite side for Friday’s operations.
Added streets for snow removal Sycaway Neighborhood
Marshland Ct Taylor Ct Woodrow Ct Lee Ave Reid Ave Warren Ave Joseph Ct Joseph St Euclid Ave (S. Lake to Eldridge Ct) Rankin Ave Eastside
Parmentre Ave Kinloch Ave Excelsior Ave Fales Ct Central Ave (Spring to Vista) Rock Ave Vista Ave Gregory Ct Kinney St Ford Ave Albia Ave Plum Ave Woodlawn Ct Fonda Ave Elmwood Ave Parkview Ct Williard Ave Monroe Ct Blakely Ct McChesney Ct Downtown / North Central
Jacob St (River to 6th) King St 5th Ave (Federal to Hoosick) South Troy
Adam St Jefferson St Ida St Canal St Madison St Monroe St Jackson St Van Buren St Harrison St Tyler St Polk St Sherman Ave (Grant to Campbell) 5th Ave (Ferry to Hill) Hill St (Spring Ave to Washington St) The streets were added to the snow removal plan following an assessment by the city’s Quality-of-Life Action Crews as they continue to clear accumulated snow from the weekend’s winter storm. The streets have been designated for snow removal only and are not being added to the city’s snow emergency route.
Residents are required to follow all updated no-parking restrictions. A full list of streets designate for snow removal can be found on the city of Troy’s website. Anyone with questions can call DPW Dispatch at 518-270-4579.
